title: Quantitative Pólya inequalities for annular sectors
summary: We prove explicit positive corrections to the Dirichlet and Neumann Pólya inequalities at every positive eigenvalue index of every annular sector. The coefficients depend only on the radii and are uniform in the aperture. Real-order angular integration preserves the exact area term, while directional rounding estimates and radial trials control all frequencies. Optimized bounds attain the sharp circular-arc coefficient for the continuous count.
